services.name: Antelope Canyon & Horseshoe Bend
services.desc: Travel from Las Vegas to Lower Antelope Canyon and Horseshoe Bend from Las Vegas. You will have a guided tour through Antelope Canyon by a Navajo Nation guide who will lead small groups through at a pace that allows everyone to see everything without getting too crowded and allows you to get the best pictures while explaining the history of this extremely unique slot canyon. After Antelope Canyon you will go to Horseshoe Bend where you have up to an hour to explore and get amazing photos. blurb: We know there are many choices in tours from Las Vegas. We know it is hard to decipher what you are actually getting through all of the marketing, fake reviews, and numerous repackaged tours that use various descriptions of the same tour. We only offer tours that have a proven record of customer satisfaction and we do not offer every possible tour just to get your money. We only work with the highest-rated companies
